target.description: Echo of the requested review target; the dispatcher enforces it (REVIEW_BINDING_MISMATCH).

reviewed_sha256.description: Echo of the hash of the artifact under review; the dispatcher requires it (missing is REVIEW_BINDING_MISMATCH).

diff_sha256.description: Echo of the implementation diff hash; required whenever target is implement.

draft_sha256.description: Echo of the writer draft hash; required whenever target is writer (writer drafts arrive in step 5).

verdict.description: pass only when there are no findings; escalate when any finding is dangerous.

findings.description: Defects only. Empty when the change is correct.
